title: Enterprise Account Manager – Healthcare Compliance (B2B, Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Manager to own our highest-value, highest-complexity client portfolio — enterprise and strategic accounts where you'll be the trusted executive partner, not just the point of contact. This is an individual-contributor role (not people management) focused on owning outcomes for a book of large, complex clients: retention, executive relationships, and long-term portfolio growth.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Client Partnership 



• Serve as the executive relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic client accounts.  

• Develop trusted partnerships with key decision-makers and executive stakeholders.  

•  Gain a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and compliance priorities.  

• Act as the client's strategic advisor by recommending solutions that improve business outcomes and strengthen the overall partnership.  

• Conduct recurring Executive Business Reviews to demonstrate value, review performance, and align future initiatives.  

• Develop and execute a Customer Council program and plan industry conferences, medical compliance forums, networking events, and educational sessions that build a strong MedPro and MP1 community, strengthen customer relationships, showcase the company's expertise and thought leadership, and position MedPro and MP1 as a trusted leader in the medical compliance industry. 



2. Client Success & Experience 



• Own the end-to-end client experience from implementation through renewal.  

• Lead onboarding validation by ensuring services, billing, contacts, and operational expectations are accurately established.  

• Monitor customer health and proactively address risks before they impact the client experience.  

• Coordinate internal resources to ensure timely resolution of client issues and escalations.  

• Drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy through proactive communication and continuous engagement.  



3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation 



• Develop and execute strategic account plans for each assigned client.  

• Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.  

• Lead renewal planning and contract discussions while protecting long-term client relationships.  

• Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities within the assigned portfolio.  

• Achieve portfolio growth objectives while ensuring every recommendation aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.  



4. Portfolio Health Management  



• Own the overall health and performance of an assigned client portfolio.  

• Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends.  

• Develop recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.  

• Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.  

• Utilize portfolio insights and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.  



5. Cross-Functional Leadership 



• Serve as the central point of coordination between clients and internal teams.  

• Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.  

• Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.  

• Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.  

• Foster collaboration that enables MedPro and MP1 to consistently exceed client expectations. 



Required Qualifications:



• 5+ years of experience managing strategic or enterprise-level client portfolios in Account Management, Customer Success, • Client Services, Business Development, or related consultative roles.  

• Demonstrated success owning a significant book of business with accountability for retention, executive relationships, and portfolio growth.  

• Proven ability to develop trusted partnerships with executive stakeholders and influence strategic business decisions.  

• Extensive experience leading Executive Business Reviews, contract renewals, and long-term account strategies.  

Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer advocacy, operational excellence, and sustainable revenue growth.  

• Demonstrated leadership in coordinating cross-functional teams to resolve complex client challenges and deliver measurable business outcomes.  

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Typical Portfolio:

High School Diploma or GED required.

• Knowledge of medical billing and coding (ICD-10, HCPCS, CPT) coding principles.

• Minimum of 1-3+ years of experience in medical billing, reimbursement, and accounts receivable

Knowledge & Skills

Strong understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial Insurance, TRICARE, and Workers' Compensation billing guidelines.

title: Recruiting & Talent Pipeline Specialist
description:
We operate multiple growing companies and are looking for a Recruiting & Talent Pipeline Specialist to continuously identify, engage, screen, and organize talented people who could become future hires across our businesses.



This is not a traditional HR administration role.



Your primary responsibility is simple: make sure we always have a strong pipeline of qualified candidates ready when we need to hire. 



Instead of beginning the search after a position becomes available, you will continuously recruit for the types of people our companies regularly need.



What You'll Do:

1 Continuously source candidates through OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn,
 groups, job boards, referrals, and other channels

2 Build and maintain candidate pipelines for multiple roles across several companies

3 Proactively reach out to qualified candidates

4 Review applications, resumes, work histories, and introductory videos

5 Conduct initial screening interviews

6 Evaluate candidates for communication skills, experience, reliability, compensation expectations, and overall fit

7 Keep detailed candidate records and notes in our recruiting system

8 Categorize candidates based on role, experience, quality, availability, and salary expectations

9 Follow up with strong candidates and keep them engaged for future opportunities

10 Post and optimize job listings

11 Test new recruiting channels and sourcing strategies

12 Coordinate interviews with company managers when a candidate is ready to move forward

13 Maintain a ready-to-hire bench for frequently hired positions



Roles You'll Recruit For



Our companies hire across a variety of functions, including:



* Sales representatives

* Customer service representatives

* Operations staff

* Specialized roles as new needs arise



You do not need to already understand every position. You need to be excellent at learning what makes someone successful in a role and finding people who match that profile.



What We're Looking For



Recruiting experience is required.



You should be someone who:



Has experience sourcing and screening candidates

Is comfortable reaching out to people proactively rather than simply waiting for applications

Has excellent written and spoken English

Is highly organized

Can manage hundreds of candidates without losing track of conversations

Is comfortable interviewing candidates on video

Has strong judgment about people

Can recognize strong candidates quickly

Is persistent and comfortable following up

Takes ownership without needing constant instructions

Enjoys searching for great people



Experience recruiting Filipino remote employees is a major advantage.



How We Measure Success



This role is primarily measured by the quality and depth of the candidate pipeline you build.



We will look at metrics such as:



Number of qualified candidates added to the pipeline each week

Number of candidates successfully screened

Quality of candidates presented to hiring managers

Response rates from outbound recruiting

Time required to produce qualified candidates when a position opens

Percentage of presented candidates who advance to interviews

Successful hires originating from your pipeline



The goal is that when one of our companies says, "We need to hire a salesperson," we aren't starting from zero. We already have qualified people to speak with.



To Apply



Please include:



A brief description of your recruiting experience

The types of positions you have recruited for

The sourcing platforms and methods you have used

An example of how you would find candidates for a difficult-to-fill position

A short video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this role



Applications without a video will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who wants to become the person responsible for building the talent engine behind a growing group of companies.

title: Video Editor // Ecom Ads
description:

Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month

Hours: Approximately 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

Location: Fully remote

Weekends: Optional but encouraged





// About the Role //



We’re hiring an experienced direct-response video editor to join our creative team long-term.



You’ll work with a fast-growing health and wellness brand scaling in the US market. We produce a high volume of paid social ads every week and spend heavily on testing, so you’ll see real performance data from your work.



This is not an entry-level position or a one-off project. You should already have strong editing skills and experience creating ads designed to convert—not simply look good.





// What You’ll Create //



You should be confident editing:



AI UGC ads

Voiceover and B-roll ads

Greenscreen and AI-avatar ads

Claymation, Pixar-style, and 3D ads

Podcast-style ads

Any new creative format currently performing well



A large part of the role involves producing and combining AI-generated assets, including UGC clips, avatars, animations, images, and B-roll.



// Skills Required //



You should be strong in:



Hooks and retention: Creating strong openings, pattern interrupts, jump cuts, zooms, and pacing that hold attention.

Pacing and rhythm: Cutting tightly to the script or voiceover without making the edit feel messy.

Visual storytelling: Building a clear visual story around a script using relevant footage, text, and creative beats.

B-roll sourcing: Finding or generating footage that strengthens the message instead of filling space.

Captions and text: Creating clean, readable, properly timed subtitles and kinetic text.

Sound design: Choosing suitable music, balancing audio, adding SFX, and ducking music beneath voiceovers.

Motion graphics: Producing clean text animations, callouts, highlights, and transitions.

Colour and cleanup: Matching footage, correcting inconsistencies, and delivering a polished final edit.

AI generation: Prompting and producing usable AI assets that blend naturally into the finished ad.

Organisation: Keeping files and projects organised while consistently meeting deadlines.

Tools



You should already be comfortable using:



CapCut

ElevenLabs

HeyGen

Kling

Veo 3

Nano Banana

Higgsfield

Other current generative-AI tools



The AI creative space changes quickly, so you must actively keep up with new tools and workflows.





// Performance Expectations // 



Deliver two high-quality ad creatives per day based on our scripts and creative styles.

Maintain at least a 70% first-pass approval rate, meaning seven out of ten submissions should be ready to test without revisions.

Remain online and responsive throughout the working week.

Manage your workload, solve problems independently, and consistently meet deadlines.

What Matters Most

Previous experience working with a DTC or e-commerce brand is required.

You understand direct-response advertising and can explain why a hook, edit, or creative concept should convert.

You use AI tools regularly and stay updated as new tools are released.

You are coachable, growth-oriented, dependable, and constantly looking to improve.

You take initiative and aim to overdeliver instead of doing the minimum.



You don’t need to be perfect on your first day, but you must be experienced enough to start contributing immediately. Our head editor will guide you on creative frameworks, hook structures, and the principles behind winning e-commerce ads.





// This Role Is Not for You If //

You create visually attractive videos but don’t understand direct response.

You need constant supervision or help managing your workload.

You resist learning new tools or changing workflows.

You are looking for a casual editing job rather than a long-term opportunity.

You aren’t genuinely interested in short-form advertising, AI creative, and performance marketing.





// How to Apply //



Send me your ad portfolio 



Along with that, send me one ad creative you’ve made that performed well. Then break down exactly why it worked from a direct-response perspective, including the hook, pacing, offer, CTA, and any specific editing choices that contributed to its performance.



Include the code word 'Blue' at the top of your application. I only review

applications that include it. This tells me you actually read the post and pay

attention to detail.



I'm looking forward to seeing what you can do and hope we can work well together.

description:
Position Summary

MTS Enterprises is seeking a dependable and highly organized Remote Field Operations Coordinator to support our day-to-day field operations. The Field Operations Coordinator will serve as the primary point of contact for clients and field subcontractors. This position will receive incoming calls and work-order requests, review our established subcontractor network to locate available coverage, contact subcontractors to verify their service area and availability, confirm coverage with clients, and follow up with assigned subcontractors through completion.



This is a communication-heavy position that requires excellent phone skills, organization, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple work orders and deadlines simultaneously.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Client & Incoming Call Management

• Receive and respond to incoming business calls.

• Communicate professionally with clients regarding contractor coverage and work-order status.

Field Subcontractor Coordination

• Review the company's existing subcontractor network to identify contractors within the required city, county, or service area.

• Confirm subcontractors can perform the requested service and meet the required deadline.

• Locate alternate coverage when an assigned subcontractor becomes unavailable.

Work Order Follow-Up

• Monitor assigned work orders from assignment through completion.

• Follow up with field subcontractors to ensure work remains on schedule.

• Contact subcontractors approximately 24 hours before applicable deadlines to confirm they are still on track for completion.

• Proactively address scheduling or coverage issues that could affect client deadlines.

• Maintain accurate records of work-order assignments, contractor communication, follow-ups, and status updates.

• Escalate issues to management when necessary.

Additional Service Coordination

• Communicate with field subcontractors regarding additional repairs, maintenance, or property preservation services identified at a property.

• Determine whether the assigned subcontractor has the experience and availability to complete additional requested services.

• Locate another qualified subcontractor from the company's network when additional coverage is needed.

title: Elite Meta & Google Ads / GoHighLevel Campaign Manager
description:
We are hiring an exceptional performance-marketing specialist to modify, manage and scale a lead-generation campaign for an Australian Mortgage Freedom business. Our core offer is Mortgage Freedom in 10 Years.



This is not a role for a general social-media manager or a contractor learning paid acquisition on the job. 



We want to hear from the best: a proven operator who can independently diagnose performance issues, protect lead quality, make sound commercial decisions, and scale a successful acquisition system with discipline.



Campaign Context and Growth Plan



The campaign will launch on Meta, initially targeting 14 selected Brisbane suburbs. Initial advertising spend will be AUD $500–$600 per week, with an initial operating target of 2 qualified leads per week. A qualified lead will be defined with us before launch using agreed eligibility and quality criteria; success will be assessed on lead quality, not lead volume alone. The funnel will support this process by filtering and qualifying prospects before they enter the sales process.



Once the campaign has proven itself, the objective is to scale progressively to 4, 6, 8, 10 and then more qualified leads per week, then expand nationally across Australia. Google Ads will be introduced as the campaign grows. You must therefore be genuinely strong in both Meta and Google Ads and comfortable operating at substantially higher budgets and geographic coverage.



Scope of the Role

You will own the day-to-day paid-acquisition management within our approved strategy. This includes campaign set-up, monitoring, testing, optimisation, troubleshooting, reporting and recommendations. You will be expected to work proactively rather than wait to be told when something is not working.



Your ongoing responsibilities will include the following.

•Manage, test and optimise Meta campaigns from launch.

•Build and manage Google Ads when it is introduced, including keyword strategy, search-term hygiene, conversion tracking and budget allocation.

•Test and improve audiences, targeting approach, creative angles, copy, offers, landing-page alignment, budgets and conversion performance.

•Monitor lead quality through the full funnel, not simply cost per lead or form submissions.

•Maintain reliable attribution and lead capture, including campaign naming, UTM discipline, platform tracking, GoHighLevel fields and source visibility.

•Review lead outcomes with us and use that feedback to improve targeting, messaging and qualification.

•Identify performance risks or technical faults early, explain the cause plainly and recommend a practical remedy.

•Provide concise weekly reporting and a clear monthly optimisation plan.

•Recommend when to hold, reduce or increase spend based on evidence, rather than scaling on vanity metrics.



The successful contractor will also advise on creative testing. Please state clearly in your application what is included in your management fee: campaign strategy, ad copy, static-creative production, video or UGC production, creative briefing, landing-page copy, or any other deliverables. Work that is not included must be scoped and approved separately before it begins.



GoHighLevel, Landing Pages and Tracking



Everything is built and owned in our existing GoHighLevel account. You must be highly confident working with GoHighLevel funnels, landing pages, forms, custom fields, automations, workflows, notifications and lead-source tracking.



Over the next 2 to 3 weeks we will review the existing landing pages and provide the required pre-launch changes. Before accepting the work, you will review the existing GoHighLevel set-up and confirm that you can make the requested modifications while preserving our approved branding, colours, fonts, styling and design.



Landing-page modifications are not included in the ongoing management fee. Any approved landing-page work will be paid separately and in addition to the monthly management fee, at your agreed hourly rate. Before any work begins, you must provide an itemised hourly rate and a time estimate for approval.



Before launch, you will test and document the complete lead journey:



Ad → Landing Page → Form → GoHighLevel → Workflow → Notification → Lead record → Lead-source reporting



The launch is not complete until the journey has been tested successfully using a real test submission and any faults have been rectified. You must be able to troubleshoot tracking and lead-capture issues across the ad platform, website or funnel, form, GoHighLevel and notification layers.



Compliance, Account Ownership and Change Control



As this is an education-focused campaign in the mortgage space, you must understand how to position and advertise mortgage education effectively while working within applicable advertising-platform requirements. You must be confident navigating the distinction between educational content and financial-product promotion, including appropriate messaging, claims, targeting and approvals. You must also flag any proposed ad copy, targeting, landing-page content or tracking approach that could create a platform-policy or compliance risk.



All advertising accounts, pixels, data, audiences, tracking assets, campaign history, landing pages, GoHighLevel assets and creative files remain our property. Work must be performed in our existing business-owned accounts; no campaign or tracking asset is to be held solely in a contractor-owned account.



No material change to budget, offer, core claims, landing-page structure, conversion event, payment settings or external integration may be made without our written approval. You will maintain a clear change log for material campaign, funnel and tracking changes, including the purpose of the change and the resulting outcome.



Performance Management and Reporting

The first engagement will be a paid 30-day initial period, allowing both parties to confirm working fit, technical competence, reporting quality, responsiveness and the integrity of the campaign set-up. Continued engagement and fee increases will be based on the actual scope, advertising spend, lead volume, geographic expansion and demonstrated contribution to qualified-lead performance. No fixed lead volume is guaranteed while the campaign is being tested and validated.



Your weekly update must be concise and commercially useful. It should show spend, leads, qualified leads where outcome data is available, cost per lead, cost per qualified lead where measurable, landing-page conversion rate, key tests or changes, material issues and the next actions. Your monthly review should explain what was learned, what will be stopped or scaled, and the proposed testing and budget plan for the following month.



• Critical issues: Broken landing page, failed form or workflow, tracking or lead-capture failure, billing issue, or campaign disruption that could result in advertising spend without leads being captured. Required response time: within 30 minutes.

• Important issues: Material performance deterioration, rejected ads affecting an active campaign, reporting discrepancies, or non-critical funnel faults. Required response time: within 4 hours.

• Routine matters: Optimisation questions, planned testing, reporting and general requests. Required response time: within 24 hours.



Please apply only if you can reliably meet these service levels, including appropriate availability for Australian business operations. In your application, state your location, time zone, normal working hours and how urgent issues will be handled outside those hours.



Essential Experience



You must have demonstrable, hands-on experience in all of the following areas:

•Meta Ads for lead generation, including campaign diagnosis, creative testing, optimisation and budget scaling.

•Google Ads for lead generation, including conversion tracking, keyword strategy, search-term analysis and campaign optimisation.

•GoHighLevel funnels, forms, workflows, automations and lead-source visibility.

•Conversion-rate optimisation for lead-generation landing pages and forms.

•Tracking, attribution, pixel or tag configuration, UTM governance and lead-capture troubleshooting.

•Lead-quality analysis and feedback loops with a sales or client-service team.

•Structured experimentation: forming a hypothesis, testing it, interpreting results and acting on the evidence.

•Clear written communication, strong analytical judgement, commercial awareness and independent problem-solving.



Direct experience with Australian lead generation, financial services, mortgages or other regulated consumer categories is strongly preferred. If you do not have that exact sector experience, explain why your comparable experience equips you to manage it safely and effectively.



Compensation and Commercial Terms

The initial ongoing management fee is AUD $200 per week, with advertising spend paid separately. Landing-page, GoHighLevel or other approved project work is paid separately at the agreed hourly rate or fixed quote.



The management fee will be reviewed and increased as campaign scope increases. In your application, provide your proposed management-fee structure for higher advertising spend, additional campaigns, Google Ads management, increased qualified-lead volume and national expansion. We are looking for transparent commercial terms and no unapproved add-on costs.



Application Requirements



A CV alone will not be sufficient. Submit a concise, tailored application that addresses each item below and demonstrates what you personally did, not only what a former agency or team achieved.



1.Summarise your direct Meta Ads experience, including the types of lead-generation campaigns and budgets you have managed.



2.Summarise your direct Google Ads experience, including search, conversion tracking and optimisation responsibilities.



3.Describe your GoHighLevel experience, specifically funnels, forms, workflows, integrations and troubleshooting.



4.Provide two relevant lead-generation examples. For each, state the sector, starting challenge, your role, actions taken, timeframe and measurable result. Anonymised evidence is acceptable.



5.Explain one campaign you materially improved through testing or optimisation. Include the initial diagnosis, test or intervention, result and what you learned.



6.Provide your hourly rate for GoHighLevel and landing-page work, plus any separate rates for creative production, copywriting or other excluded services.



7.Confirm your location, time zone, availability and normal response time. Confirm explicitly that you can meet the response standards above.



8.Outline the first three things you would audit in our Meta-to-GoHighLevel funnel before launch, and why.



9.State your proposed fee structure as media spend, channel scope and geographic coverage increase.



10.Provide two professional references or client-verifiable proof points, where available.



Only 3 candidates will be shortlisted for a second-round practical assessment. This assessment will focus on how you diagnose a scenario, prioritise actions, identify tracking or funnel risks, and communicate a commercially sound recommendation.



Final Note



We are building a long-term acquisition engine, not hiring someone to watch a dashboard. We expect ownership, precision, honest reporting, reliable communication and consistent improvement.



We want to hear from the best. If you have the proven judgement, technical depth and commercial discipline to lead this work independently, we encourage you to apply.

title: Staffing Operations Specialist
description:

This company uses technology to make it easier for businesses to access and manage security services. This role will help make sure staffing requests are handled quickly, shifts are fulfilled, and both workers and clients have the support they need.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and moving quickly. You'll manage daily staffing operations, coordinate workers and schedules, support clients, and help keep operations running smoothly.



As their first offshore operations hire, you'll have a lot of ownership and a direct impact on the overall business. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, make decisions, work independently, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

- Coordinate with workers and partners to make sure staffing requests are fulfilled accurately and on time.

- Communicate with workers to coordinate shifts, answer questions, and resolve issues.

- Communicate with clients about staffing needs, schedule changes, and operational issues.

- Help onboard new workers and ensure they are ready for their assignments.

- Monitor daily operations and quickly address issues as they come up.

- Manage internal communications and make sure important information gets to the right people quickly.

- Identify operational problems and find practical ways to improve processes.

- Give feedback to the product and engineering team when something isn't working or could be improved.

- Use Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to solve problems, improve workflows, and work more efficiently.

- Take on different responsibilities as the company grows.



What We're Looking For 

- 2+ years of experience in staffing, workforce management, or operations, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience coordinating shifts, schedules, workers, or real-time staffing needs.

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients, workers, or operations is highly preferred.

- Previous startup experience is a strong plus.

- Comfortable communicating directly with both clients and workers.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle issues quickly as they come up.

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and make decisions without needing constant direction.

- Flexible and comfortable taking on different types of work as priorities change.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to solve problems, improve workflows, or automate tasks.

- Comfortable learning new systems and working with technology.

- Willing to speak up, share ideas, and give feedback when something isn't working.

- Security industry or other shift-based staffing experience is a plus, but not required.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated WFH setup required.

- Base salary: 65,000 PHP per month

- Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays

title: Account Coordinator – Digital Marketing
description:
Account Coordinator – Digital Marketing



Salary: $1,200 USD/month

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 4 PM ET

Location: Remote



Overview:



We’re looking for a friendly, organized, and highly responsive Account Coordinator to join a growing U.S. digital marketing agency.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with clients, keeping projects organized, and making sure communication never falls through the cracks. You’ll serve as an important connection between clients and the agency’s internal teams, helping everyone stay informed, aligned, and moving forward.



You won’t be expected to run advertising campaigns or perform deep data analysis. Instead, your strength will be communication, coordination, follow-through, and creating a great client experience.



If you’re a strong writer, naturally organized, comfortable communicating with clients, and enjoy being the person who keeps things moving, we’d love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities:

- Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for clients through Slack and

- Coordinate client feedback, questions, updates, and next steps with internal teams

- Help schedule client meetings and keep calendars and timelines organized

- Provide regular client touchpoints during onboarding, campaign launches, and ongoing work

- Distribute performance reports and help clients receive the information they need

- Pull basic month-over-month information from existing reports when needed

- Work closely with internal media and creative teams to keep projects and deliverables moving

- Track deadlines, follow up on outstanding items, and make sure responsibilities are clear

- Route questions to the appropriate team member when additional expertise is needed

- Identify potential communication or scheduling issues early and raise them before they become bigger problems

- Help create a smooth, responsive, and positive experience for every client



Tools You Should Know:

You should be comfortable working in:

- Google Sheets

- Google Slides

- Google Drive

- Gmail and Google Workspace

- Slack



Experience working around Google Ads and Meta Ads is helpful. You do not need to be a media buyer or campaign strategist, but you should be comfortable learning digital marketing terminology and understanding the basics of how campaigns work.



What Success Looks Like:

- Clients receive clear, professional, and timely communication

- Questions and requests are acknowledged quickly and don't get lost

- Internal teams have the information they need to complete their work

- Deadlines, meetings, feedback, and follow-ups stay organized

- Clients know what is happening without needing to chase the team for updates

- You know when you can handle something yourself and when to bring in the right team member

- You become someone both clients and teammates trust to keep things moving



What We’re Looking For:

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Previous experience communicating directly with clients or customers in a professional environment

- Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through

- A responsive communication style and good judgment around urgency

- Confidence managing multiple conversations, deadlines, and priorities at the same time

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Familiarity with Google Workspace

- A basic understanding of digital marketing



Experience working for a marketing, advertising, digital, or creative agency is strongly preferred, especially if you have supported U.S. or international clients.



You do not need to be an expert in paid media, and you will not be expected to personally manage Google Ads or Meta campaigns.



Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is warm, dependable, coachable, proactive, and enjoyable to work with.



What You Get:

- $1,200 USD/month

- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Opportunity to work directly with an established U.S. marketing agency

- Stable role with room to learn and grow

- A collaborative, relaxed, and friendly team environment

- Ongoing HR and employment support from Workspark



Remote Work Requirements:

- Reliable computer, webcam, and headset

- Reliable backup internet or another plan for unexpected connectivity issues

title: Strategic Sales Closer
description:
About the Role:


 is a growing lead generation and marketing company that connects businesses across multiple industries with high-intent prospective customers. Our primary market has historically been legal, where we work with law firms across the U.S., but we also operate in other verticals including home services, insurance, finance, real estate, and education.



We’re looking for an experienced B2B Sales Closer for our legal market who is comfortable owning the sales process from initial conversation through signed business.



This is not primarily an appointment-setting role. While outbound prospecting will be part of the position, success will ultimately be measured by your ability to build relationships, understand a prospect's needs, handle objections, and convert opportunities into new clients.



You’ll work with two types of opportunities:



-Warm inbound leads generated through our own websites and marketing channels

-Outbound opportunities that you identify, contact, and develop into new business



We’re looking for someone who is confident speaking directly with attorneys, firm owners, and marketing decision-makers and who knows how to move a sales conversation forward without relying heavily on scripts.



We also expect our team to use modern technology intelligently. Strong candidates should already be comfortable using AI, prospecting databases, CRM tools, and other sales technology to research prospects, prepare for calls, personalize outreach, and manage their pipeline efficiently.



As 
 expands, there may also be opportunities for successful sales reps to help us grow into additional industries, including our developing home improvement lead generation vertical.



What You'll Do:

-Manage the sales process from initial contact through close.

-Follow up with warm inbound opportunities generated through 
 marketing.

-Build and develop your own outbound pipeline of qualified law firm prospects.

-Reach decision-makers through phone,
, video meetings, and other appropriate outreach channels.

-Conduct consultative sales conversations to understand each firm's practice areas, lead needs, budget, geography, and growth goals.

-Present 
 products and recommend lead programs that fit the prospect's needs.

-Handle objections, negotiate terms when appropriate, and confidently ask for the business.

-Maintain consistent follow-up with opportunities throughout the sales cycle.

-Keep accurate records of conversations, pipeline activity, and next steps in HubSpot.

-Use prospecting databases and research tools to identify qualified companies and decision-makers.

-Use AI tools to research prospects, prepare for calls, personalize outreach, improve follow-up, and work more efficiently.

-Work closely with management to continuously improve messaging, targeting, and sales strategy.



What We're Looking For:

-2+ years of B2B sales experience with demonstrated experience closing business.

-A track record of meeting or exceeding sales or revenue goals.

-Experience managing opportunities beyond the appointment-setting stage.

-Strong spoken and written English with the ability to communicate naturally and professionally with U.S.-based business owners and executives.

-Confidence conducting unscripted phone and video sales conversations.

-Strong objection-handling, follow-up, and negotiation skills.

-Comfortable prospecting and creating new opportunities in addition to working inbound leads.

-Experience using a CRM to manage pipeline and follow-up.

-Comfortable adopting new technology and already using AI tools regularly as part of your daily workflow.

-Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional work environment, and dependable call equipment.

-Self-motivated, organized, accountable, and receptive to coaching.



Experience selling directly to U.S.-based business owners, executives, or other decision-makers is strongly preferred. Experience selling to law firms, professional services companies, lead generation companies, or regulated industries is a plus, but legal industry experience is not required.



Required Tools & Software Experience:

You should be comfortable working with modern sales, research, and productivity tools, including:



-Google Workspace — Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and Google Meet

-HubSpot for CRM, pipeline management, follow-up, and activity tracking


, 
, or similar prospecting/data platforms for researching companies, identifying decision-makers, and building outbound lists

-ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or comparable AI tools



AI is part of how our team works.



We expect sales reps to use these tools for prospect research, account preparation, outreach personalization, follow-up, objection research, and general productivity.



If you are not already using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity regularly in your day-to-day work, you likely won't be the right fit for how our team operates.



Work Schedule:



This position works during U.S. Pacific business hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time.



For candidates in the Philippines, this will generally be:



11:30 PM-8:00 AM Manila time, shifting approximately one hour during part of the year due to U.S. daylight saving time.



Because this position requires live conversations with U.S. prospects and clients, candidates must be comfortable maintaining this schedule long-term.



Compensation

-Base pay: $5-$7.50 USD/hour, depending on experience

-Plus uncapped performance-based commission

-Commission increases as your total book of business and revenue grow

-Full-time, Monday-Friday



Our commission structure is designed to reward reps who consistently build and retain a strong book of business. Higher revenue levels qualify for higher commission percentages across the business you have closed and continue to manage.



Commission tiers:

-Below 100% of your monthly revenue target: no commission for that month

-100%–109.99% of your monthly revenue target: 3% commission, calculated as (net revenue − monthly base pay) × 3%

-110%+ of your monthly revenue target: 4% commission, calculated the same way at the higher rate

-Monthly revenue targets will be set and communicated in advance, and reviewed periodically as your book of business grows



How to Apply. Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A brief cover letter explaining your sales background and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.

3. A 60-90 second voice or video introduction telling us about yourself and your sales experience.



The recording does not need to be highly produced or scripted. We simply want to hear how you communicate naturally, since live conversations with prospects are an important part of the position.



Applications that do not include all three items may not move forward in the hiring process.



Application Questions



1. Are you able to consistently work approximately 11:30 PM-8:00 AM Manila time, with the schedule shifting by approximately one hour during part of the year?

Yes / No



2. Tell us about your most recent sales role. What were you selling, who were you selling to, and what part of the sales process did you personally manage?



3. What was your approximate close rate in your most recent role, and how was it measured?



4. Tell us about a deal you personally closed that required you to overcome objections or negotiate with the prospect.



5. How many years of experience do you have closing B2B sales?



6. Have you previously worked with a sales or revenue quota? If so, what was your goal and how consistently did you achieve it?



7. What was the typical monthly value or contract value of the deals you were responsible for closing?



8. Do you have experience selling directly to U.S.-based business owners, executives, or other decision-makers? If so, briefly describe the types of clients you worked with.



9. Do you have experience selling to law firms, professional services companies, lead generation companies, or another regulated B2B industry? Please briefly explain.



10. Which of the following have you used professionally: Google Workspace, HubSpot, 
, 
, or another prospecting database?



11. Which AI tools do you currently use in your day-to-day work, and how do you use them?



12. Are you comfortable with a compensation structure consisting of hourly base pay plus commission that increases as your total book of business grows?



13. In a few sentences, tell us what you believe makes you especially effective at closing sales.

title: Meta Ads Specialist (DTC E-Commerce Focus + B2B Lead Gen)
description:
Compensation:

About Fur Theory

Fur Theory is a premium, Australian-made luxury canine care brand. We operate a high-margin business focused primarily on Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) sales via Shopify, supported by a select wholesale network of boutique stockists and grooming salons. We are launching lean and need our ad dollars to drive immediate DTC sales volume.

What This Role IS NOT

This is not a role for an admin assistant who just clicks "Boost Post" or sets up a broad campaign and forgets it. We need a proactive performance marketer who understands e-commerce funnel dynamics, tests creative aggressively, tracks true customer acquisition costs, and knows how to turn ad dollars into DTC revenue.

What We Need You To Do

 Primary — Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Growth: Build, test, and scale Meta conversion campaigns aimed at pet parents to drive high-AOV (Average Order Value) sales on Shopify.

 Secondary — B2B Retailer Acquisition: Run targeted, low-spend lead generation campaigns aimed at boutique owners and grooming salons to apply for wholesale packs.

 Creative Strategy & Directing: Analyze video performance down to the second. Tell us why an ad isn't converting (weak hook, low click-through rate, high drop-off) and give us clear briefs for new ad concepts to test.

 Technical Setup: Ensure rock-solid tracking with Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and Shopify server-side tracking post-iOS14.

 Performance Reporting: Deliver zero-fluff reporting focused on key e-commerce metrics: ROAS, Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Cost Per Lead (CPL), and Average Order Value (AOV).

Proof of Results Required to Apply

Applications without the following will be automatically rejected:

1. 2–3 Real DTC E-Commerce Case Studies: Specific data showing monthly ad spend managed, CPA/ROAS achieved, and product category (client names can be redacted for NDA).

2. Ads Manager Screenshots: Actual Ads Manager dashboard proof supporting your case studies.

3. Your Creative Testing Framework (3–5 sentences): Explain how you test new ad angles/hooks, how long you run tests before turning off bad ads, and how you scale winners.

How to Apply

Reply with your DTC case studies, Ads Manager screenshots, hourly rate/retainer, and your testing process.

Why This Works Better For Your New Focus

1. DTC Marketers Excel at Creative: Pure DTC ad managers live and breathe visual hooks, unboxing videos, before-and-after coat results, and UGC (user-generated content). That is exactly what sells $49.95 dog wash to pet owners on Instagram.

2. Wholesale Runs in the Background: A great DTC ad manager can set up a simple, highly targeted B2B campaign running in the background for $5–$10/day targeting "Pet Store Owners" or "Grooming Salons" in Australia while 90% of your budget drives consumer website sales.

3. Filters for High-AOV Experience: Because your Duo System MSRP is $89.90, this job ad targets marketers who know how to sell premium, higher-ticket bundles directly to consumers!



(Part-Time to start (~10–15 hours/week to launch), scaling with spend)

title: Platform Developer - Claude Code
description:
Company: Kind Bidder



Kind Bidder is an auction platform built for nonprofits, by people who've spent 15+ years running auctions and fundraising campaigns. Beyond the software, we run done-for-you auctions and fundraising for the nonprofits we serve.



We're a public benefit company, and we're building toward an employee-owned model. As we grow, you grow with us.



We're not looking for someone who wants a job to clock in and out of. We want a builder who's excited about what we're creating and hungry to grow with us.



The Role



We have a working platform, but it was built to get us to today, not to carry us into the future. We need a developer who can take ownership of rebuilding and scaling Kind Bidder into a platform that serves nonprofits for the next decade.



This starts as a contract role with a clear path to full-time for the right person. We want to prove the workload and the fit together before committing to a full-time salary. If you're the right developer, this converts fast.



This is a remote position. You need to be available US business hours, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific, with a 1-hour lunch break. You'll report directly to the CEO and founder.



What You'll Own



Audit the current Kind Bidder platform and figure out what needs to be rebuilt versus refactored

title: SEO STRATEGIST & TECHNICAL SEO SPECIALIST
description:
One-Off Audit, Strategy & Growth Roadmap | Wix Website



Inner Life School is looking for an experienced SEO strategist to review, refine and strengthen the SEO foundations already in place across our growing online course and content platform.



This is not a full-time role and not a standard monthly SEO retainer.



We have already completed a significant amount of the foundational SEO work, including page optimisation, SEO titles, meta descriptions, keyword targeting, structured content and ongoing blog creation.



We are now looking for an experienced SEO professional to take an expert-level view of what has been built, identify anything that has been missed, address technical issues and create a clear, strategic roadmap for future organic growth.



Our website is built on **Wix**, so experience working with Wix SEO is important.



About Inner Life School



Inner Life School is an online personal development platform for women, offering self-paced courses and content designed around self-awareness, personal growth, emotional patterns, relationships, self-worth and other areas of inner development.



We are building a substantial library of high-quality, long-form editorial content alongside our online courses.



Our goal is not simply to publish blog articles. We want to build a strong, interconnected content ecosystem that can grow organic visibility and attract the right audience to both our content and courses over time.



WHAT WE NEED



We are looking for someone to conduct a comprehensive review of our existing SEO work and provide both **technical expertise and strategic direction**.



The scope may include:



Technical SEO Review



Review the existing website and identify any technical SEO issues or opportunities, including:



* Google Search Console setup and performance

* Indexing and crawlability

* XML sitemap

* Robots directives

* Canonicalisation and duplicate content

* Redirects and broken links

* Core Web Vitals and site performance

* Mobile usability

* Image optimisation

* Structured data and schema

* Any Wix-specific SEO issues or opportunities



Where possible, we would prefer the successful applicant to **implement technical fixes**, rather than simply provide a report listing what needs to be done.



SEO Audit of Existing Content



Review the SEO foundations already in place across:



* Course pages

* Blog articles

* Core website pages

* Existing metadata

* Keywords and search intent

* URL structure

* Internal linking



We do not want someone to unnecessarily redo work that has already been completed. We want an experienced eye to identify where the existing strategy is strong, where gaps exist and what should be improved.



Keyword & Topic Strategy



Develop a clear SEO strategy around the topics and courses we are building.



This should include identifying:



* Priority keyword opportunities

* Search intent

* Topic clusters

* Pillar content opportunities

* Supporting article opportunities

* Content gaps

* Existing articles that could be strengthened or expanded

* Opportunities to build authority around our core subject areas



Our content covers areas including personal development, self-awareness, childhood patterns, relationships, self-worth, emotional patterns, personal growth and money mindset.



We want a strategy that connects our blog content with our courses rather than treating every page as an isolated piece of content.



Content & Internal Linking Architecture



Create a practical content architecture that shows how our content should work together.



This should include:



* Which topics should become major content pillars

* Supporting article recommendations

* Internal linking opportunities

* Which articles should lead naturally towards relevant courses

* Priority content to create over the next 6–12 months



The goal is to create a clear roadmap that our internal team can continue implementing.



Long-Term SEO Roadmap



At the end of the project, we want to have a practical strategy we can work from.



This should clearly outline:



* Priority SEO actions

* Technical issues requiring attention

* Keyword and topic priorities

* Recommended content roadmap

* Internal linking strategy

* Existing content to optimise

* New content opportunities

* A repeatable SEO process for future blog articles and course pages



 What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* Demonstrated experience developing SEO strategies for content-led websites

* Strong technical SEO knowledge

* Experience with **Wix SEO**

* Experience using Google Search Console and SEO tools

* A strong understanding of keyword research, search intent and topical authority

* Experience developing content strategies and topic clusters

* The ability to explain recommendations clearly and practically

* A willingness to work with and improve an existing SEO foundation rather than applying a generic SEO package



Experience with **online education, digital products, wellness, personal development or female-focused brands** would be highly regarded.



## This Is Not What We Are Looking For



We are not looking for:



* A generic monthly SEO package

* Someone whose primary service is writing blog articles

* Keyword stuffing or outdated SEO tactics

* Automated reports with little strategic insight

* Someone who simply changes title tags and meta descriptions

* A long-term retainer before we understand what work is actually required



We are looking for an experienced strategist who can look at the business as a whole and help us build a smart, sustainable organic growth strategy.



## Project Structure



Initially, this will be a **defined project**, covering the audit, technical review, strategic recommendations and SEO roadmap.



There may be an opportunity for **ongoing quarterly reviews or consulting** after the initial project, depending on the results and what the business requires.



## When Applying



Please include:



1. Examples of SEO strategies or audits you have completed.

2. Your experience working with Wix websites.

3. Examples of content-led websites you have helped grow organically.

4. A brief outline of how you would approach this project.

5. Your proposed project fee or pricing structure.

6. What SEO tools you use.

7. Whether you personally implement technical fixes or provide recommendations for the client to implement.



**We are looking for expertise, strategic thinking and practical execution — not a generic SEO package.**

title: WFM (Multiple Campaigns)
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Workforce Manager to join us. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the forecasting, scheduling, and real-time management of our contact center operations. You will act as a critical partner to our Operations team, ensuring that we meet our Service Level Agreements (SLAs) while optimizing staff utilization, managing shrinkage, and driving operational efficiency.



The ideal candidate is highly analytical, decisive, and has a proven track record of managing workforce operations in a dynamic, high-volume environment.



Key Responsibilities

Forecasting & Capacity Planning: Develop accurate short-term and long-term volume, Average Handle Time (AHT), and staffing forecasts to ensure optimal headcount across multiple queues and channels (voice, chat,
).



Scheduling: Oversee the creation and optimization of schedules to meet anticipated contact volumes while balancing employee needs and minimizing overtime.



Real-Time Management: Lead the real-time monitoring team to track intraday performance. Make immediate operational adjustments to staffing and routing to ensure SLAs and abandonment rate targets are met.



Reporting & Analytics: Generate, analyze, and present daily, weekly, and monthly reports on key performance metrics (Service Level, Occupancy, Shrinkage, Schedule Adherence).



Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Operations, Training teams to align on hiring plans, nesting schedules, and offline activities (coaching, team meetings) without compromising service levels.



Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in current WFM processes and implement data-driven solutions to improve overall productivity.



Team Leadership: Mentor, train, and lead a team of Workforce Analysts and Real-Time Analysts (RTAs).

Qualifications & Work Experience



Experience: 



Minimum of 3–5 years of dedicated experience in Workforce Management within a BPO or contact center environment.

Leadership: At least 2 years of experience in a WFM leadership role, directly overseeing analysts or schedulers.



Technical Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with industry-standard WFM software (e.g., NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, Aspect/Alvaria, or similar tools).



Data Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, complex formulas, macros/VBA is a plus) for data modeling and reporting.



Analytical Thinking: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable operational strategies.



Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present data confidently to senior leadership.



Adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and pivot strategies quickly during unforeseen volume spikes or system outages.

title: Labor Compliance Specialist/Auditor
description:
Position Overview



Veracity Compliance, Inc. is seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized Labor Compliance Specialist / Auditor to support the review, auditing, and administration of labor compliance requirements for public works, federally funded, and other regulated construction projects. The ideal candidate must be able to follow instructions carefully, adhere to established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain accurate and orderly documentation, and consistently complete detailed processes without skipping required steps.



This is not strictly an administrative compliance position. We are specifically seeking a candidate with a strong auditing and accounting background who is comfortable reviewing payroll records, reconciling financial information, identifying discrepancies, documenting findings, and conducting detailed compliance reviews.



The ideal candidate understands how financial records connect and has experience in auditing, accounting, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, or financial reconciliation. Prior labor compliance or construction experience is highly preferred but may not be required for an exceptional accounting/audit candidate who can learn regulatory requirements quickly.



A CPA, CPA candidate, or candidate with formal accounting/auditing credentials is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities:



Labor Compliance & Auditing



Conduct detailed audits of contractor and subcontractor labor compliance documentation.

Review Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Compare payroll records against supporting documentation to identify inconsistencies or potential violations.

Audit employee classifications, wage rates, fringe benefits, hours worked, overtime, deductions, and payroll calculations.

Identify underpayments, overpayments, missing documentation, discrepancies, and other compliance deficiencies.

Review payroll registers, timecards, proof of payment, canceled checks, direct-deposit records, invoices, and other supporting financial documentation.

Calculate potential wage restitution and document the basis for audit findings.

Maintain detailed audit trails and supporting documentation.

Prepare clear audit findings, deficiency notices, and compliance correspondence.

Follow up with contractors and subcontractors regarding outstanding deficiencies and corrective actions.

Assist with internal and external compliance audits and investigations.

Accounting & Financial Review

Perform detailed reconciliations between payroll, accounting records, supporting documentation, and compliance submissions.

Review AP and AR documentation when relevant to compliance verification.

Trace transactions and payments through supporting accounting records.

Identify mathematical errors, duplicate transactions, inconsistencies, missing payments, and unsupported amounts.

Analyze spreadsheets and large volumes of financial information with a high degree of accuracy.

Verify calculations independently rather than relying solely on information provided by contractors.

Maintain organized records capable of supporting an audit, investigation, or agency review.

Public Works & Prevailing Wage Compliance



Depending on experience and assigned projects, responsibilities may include:



California prevailing wage compliance

Davis-Bacon / Davis-Bacon Related Acts

Certified payroll auditing

DIR requirements and eCPR

WH-347 payroll review

Prevailing wage determinations

Fringe benefit verification

Worker classification review

Overtime requirements

Apprenticeship requirements

DAS 140 and DAS 142 documentation

Apprenticeship ratios

Restitution calculations

Contractor and subcontractor compliance

Agency and client audit preparation

Labor compliance tracking systems and reporting



Training may be provided on specific labor compliance regulations and systems for candidates with exceptional accounting and auditing qualifications.



REQUIRED Qualifications



Candidates must have professional experience in auditing, accounting, or financial review, including experience with Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, reconciliations, or similar accounting functions.

description:
Customer Success Officer — Remote - Australian AEST time



SDS Saunas is hiring a remote Customer Success Officer to own the customer experience after the sale is made. If you genuinely care about making people feel looked after, and you want to be paid for the results you create, this role is built for you.



About the Role

This is a remote, customer success-focused role. Once a sale is completed, whether it came through the website directly or via the sales team, this officer becomes the customer's main point of contact, introduced to them as part of the sales-to-support handover.



From there, the officer owns every inquiry relating to the product: delivery, installation, issues, questions, and maintenance. The aim is a white-glove experience, helping the customer get the best and most effective use out of their product, quickly and with minimal issues. The mission of the role is simple: make it a five-star experience, every time.



A core priority of this role is keeping the customer at the centre of a single, smooth line of contact, so there's no back-and-forth between sales, support, and the client. Any issue that arises after the sale is handled directly by this officer.



Key Responsibilities

• Be the customer's first point of contact after a completed sale, via the formal sales-to-support handover process.

• Own all post-sale inquiries: delivery, installation, product issues, general questions, and maintenance.

• Deliver a white-glove experience — proactive, responsive, and focused on the customer getting full, effective use of their product with minimal friction.



• Proactively reach out to clients to check they're happy with their product and request feedback on their experience.

• Collect five-star reviews across Google and Trustpilot, and product reviews, using incentives to encourage participation.

• Collect short video testimonials from happy (five-star) clients.

• Introduce SDS's customer referral program to clients, across its different reward levels.

• Act as the single owner of any post-sale issue, so it never has to bounce between the client, sales, and support.

• Liaise between Support, Sales Reps, Warehousing, and third-party logistics to resolve client requests and changes.

• Escalate warranty issues to Support, providing the additional technical information needed based on what the client has reported.



Pay & Progression



Base hourly rate, progressing through three tiers based on five-star reviews collected, time served, and a track record of minimal negative client experiences.



Tier Rate Promotion Milestone 

Junior Customer Success Officer - $7.87 USD/hr Starting tier

Customer Success Officer - $9.30 USD/hr First 30 five-star reviews collected

Senior Customer Success Officer -$10.73 USD/hr 150 five-star reviews collected



Performance Incentives

On top of the base hourly rate, you earn a commission on every five-star review and every successful referral you generate:



Action Bonus

Five-star review collected $7.15 USD

Short testimonial video collected from a five-star client $21.45 USD

Paid referral from a client $71.51 USD



Figures shown in USD at an approximate AUD → USD rate of 0.715 (rates fluctuate). Base pay is set in AUD; this posting shows the USD equivalent for candidates outside Australia.



Hours & Leave

• 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

• 30-minute meal break each day.

• 2 weeks paid annual leave, taken as the Christmas shutdown period.



What We're Looking For

• Top-level customer service ability — someone who makes people feel genuinely looked after.

• A personal, understanding temperament — this role is about real relationships with clients, not scripted transactions.

• Proactive and resourceful — comfortable owning a problem through to resolution without needing to hand it off.



How to Apply



Submit a short video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself. In it, cover:

title: Intake Specialist/Legal Secratary
description:
About the Firm:

North Star Law, PC is a plaintiff-side employment law firm based in Los Angeles. We represent California employees in wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and wage-and-hour matters. We are a modern, technology-forward practice: our intake pipeline, case management, document drafting, and court filing workflows are built around AI-assisted systems that the firm has developed in-house. You will be trained directly by the firm’s principal attorney on these systems and will take over the day-to-day operation of workflows he currently runs himself.



About the Role:

The Intake Specialist owns the front door of the firm. You will be the first person a prospective client speaks with, and you are responsible for moving every lead from first contact through consultation to a signed retainer. The firm receives a steady stream of referrals from partner law firms and website inquiries; your job is to make sure no lead goes cold. You will work inside the firm’s intake tracking dashboard and AI-assisted follow-up system, which the principal attorney will train you on personally.



Responsibilities

• Process new intakes from referral partners and website forms: capture the caller’s name, contact information, employer, and a clear summary of the potential claims.

• Conduct initial screening calls with prospective clients — gather the key facts of a potential wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, or wage-and-hour claim with empathy and accuracy.

• Run the firm’s follow-up pipeline: send and track text and call follow-ups through the firm’s phone platform, keep every lead’s stage current on the intake board, and know when to escalate a hot lead to the attorney.

• Schedule consultations against the attorney’s calendar and confirm appointments so consults actually happen.

• Send retainer agreements for e-signature, follow up until signed, and kick off new-client onboarding (welcome text, document request, file setup).

• Maintain clean records: log every contact attempt and outcome, keep the intake tracker accurate, and coordinate status updates with referring firms.

Qualifications

• 1+ year of experience in legal intake, sales, customer service, or a similar phone-heavy client-facing role (law firm experience a plus, not required).

• Excellent phone presence: warm, professional, and persistent without being pushy.

• Highly organized — comfortable managing dozens of open leads at different stages without dropping any.

• Comfortable learning new software quickly; the role runs on the firm’s custom dashboards and AI-assisted tools, and full training is provided.

• Strong written communication for text and
 follow-ups.

• Strong verbal communication skills.



What We Offer:

• Full-time position.

• Direct training and mentorship from the firm’s principal attorney.

• A front-row seat in a growing plaintiff-side employment practice that invests in modern tools instead of busywork.

• We are looking for someone who would like to stay and grow with the firm.

title: Web Illustrator for SEO Content — Invoice and Small-Business Topics
description:
# Web Illustrator for SEO Content — Invoice and Small-Business Topics



We’re looking for a talented illustrator based in the Philippines to create original web graphics for an SEO landing page about our online invoice generator.



You’ll turn written content into clear, polished visuals that help freelancers, contractors, and small-business owners understand how to create and send professional invoices.



This is a project-based remote role with the potential for ongoing work across our invoicing guides, templates, and blog content.



## Initial Project



Create a cohesive set of illustrations for our **Free Online Invoice Generator** page.



The page explains:



- How to create an invoice step by step

- What information an invoice should contain

- Who the invoice generator is designed for

- How users can customize, download, and send invoices

- How customers can pay through supported payment options

- Why online invoice generators are useful



Your illustrations should make these ideas easier to understand without distracting from the invoice-building tool or primary call to action.



## Suggested Deliverables



The initial project may include:



- One hero illustration featuring a professional digital invoice

- A visual explaining the invoice-creation process

- Small feature illustrations or icons for invoicing, calculations, branding, PDF downloads, sharing, and payments

- Audience illustrations for freelancers, contractors, consultants, tradespeople, and small businesses

- One visual showing the essential parts of a professional invoice

- Desktop and mobile-ready versions where needed

- Editable source files and optimized web exports



The final scope and number of illustrations will be agreed upon before work begins.



## What You’ll Do



- Read the supplied SEO content and identify useful visual opportunities

- Translate invoicing concepts into simple, understandable illustrations

- Develop a consistent visual direction that fits the Invoice Maker brand

- Create original illustrations rather than relying on generic stock graphics

- Maintain a clean, modern style appropriate for a financial product

- Design visuals that work alongside headings, body copy, and calls to action

- Prepare graphics for responsive desktop and mobile layouts

- Optimize exported files for fast page loading

- Revise illustrations based on creative and product feedback

- Deliver organized, editable source files



## Visual Direction



We want illustrations that feel:



- Professional but approachable

- Modern, clean, and trustworthy

- Useful rather than purely decorative

- Easy to understand at a glance

- Consistent across the full page

- Appropriate for freelancers and small-business owners

- Distinctive to Invoice Maker



The artwork should complement the actual product interface without misleading users about how the invoice generator works.



## Originality Requirements



All submitted artwork must be original and created specifically for this project.



- Do not copy another company’s illustrations, icons, interface, or visual style

- Do not submit traced, lightly modified, or unlicensed stock artwork

- All fonts, textures, icons, and supporting assets must be properly licensed for commercial use

- Disclose any stock assets, templates, or AI-assisted tools used during production

- AI-generated images must not be used in final deliverables unless we approve them in advance

- Final files must not contain distorted text, inaccurate invoice details, or visual artifacts

- We must receive commercial usage rights to the approved final artwork



You will be responsible for ensuring that your work is original and does not violate third-party copyrights or licenses.



## Required Skills



- Strong illustration and visual communication skills

- Experience creating illustrations for websites or digital products

- Ability to simplify business or financial concepts visually

- Strong understanding of composition, color, hierarchy, and consistency

- Experience preparing responsive, web-optimized assets

- Careful attention to interface details and written content

- Ability to accept feedback and complete revisions reliably

- Clear written communication and dependable deadline management



Experience with Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Affinity Designer, or similar software is preferred.



## File Requirements



Final deliverables should generally include:



- Editable source files

- SVG files for scalable web graphics where appropriate

- Optimized WebP or PNG exports where raster files are needed

- Clearly named and organized layers

- Desktop and mobile variations when required

- Documentation for any third-party fonts or licensed assets



Illustrations must remain clear at their intended display size and should be optimized to avoid unnecessary page weight.



## Role Details
